prompt: What share of all orders placed in March 2025 did the stores of each country get? Use the country_code of the store that took the order; the webshop counts as NL. order_ts holds UTC time: an order counts when its UTC date is from 1 to 31 March 2025. Return three columns, in this order: country_code, n_orders and share_of_orders, the country's orders divided by all March 2025 orders, as a ratio rounded to 4 decimals. Return one row for each country with orders. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, attach the one-row total to every country row with a join that needs no condition.
total has exactly one row, so pairing it with every country row repeats nothing; then divide each country's count by it.
faded_shape:
WITH by_country AS (SELECT s.country_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY s.country_code),
total AS (SELECT SUM(n_orders) AS n_all FROM by_country)
SELECT b.country_code, b.n_orders, ROUND(b.n_orders / t.n_all, 4) AS share_of_orders
FROM by_country b
why_this_works: total has one row, so CROSS JOIN adds n_all to every country row without repeating any, and the division gives each country its share.
